metadata.description: Public marketplace for the Rocapine Onboarding SDK plugin, so partner studios outside Rocapine can install it with `/plugin marketplace add Rocapine/react-native-onboarding`.

plugins.name: react-native-onboarding
plugins.description: End-to-end workflow for building and updating Rocapine Onboarding Studio flows: author step JSON, integrate the headless + UI SDKs, wire paywalls and their billing adapter, customize theme/components, and review onboarding quality.
